title: Mini Cloud Set Loose Translucent Talc-Free Setting + Blurring Powder

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, alcoholFree, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Long-wearing✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Good for: Pores✓ Natural Finish✓ Clean at Sephora

What it is: A talc-free ultra-translucent 12-hour setting and baking powder that visibly blurs, brightens, and sweeps away shine (not glow).

Finish: Natural


Formulation: Loose Powder


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Bamboo Stem Extract: Absorbs excess sebum so skin feels soft and fresh.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.


What Else You Need to Know: This featherweight powder melts into skin with an airbrushed finish—never cakey, powdery, or drying. It sweeps away the look of pores and fine lines for a smoother, he

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
To Bake:

-Use a powder puff to apply a generous layer of powder where you experience the most creasing or oil breakthrough.

-Let sit for a few minutes and then brush off the excess.


To Set:

-Use a fluffy powder brush to dust a light layer of product all over face—focusing on areas where you experience the most oil breakthrough.

-Use the Kosas Face Detailer Brush (sold separately) for smaller areas like under eyes.

Ingredients+

-Bamboo Stem Extract: Absorbs excess sebum so skin feels soft and fresh.


Mica, Silica, Isodecyl Neopentanoate, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Extract, Boron Nitride, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, C15-19 Alkane, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Citric Acid, Glyceryl Undecylenate, Glyceryl Caprylate, Pentylene Glycol, Sodium Dehydroacetate [+/-: Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Red 6 (CI 15850)].


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
